related_pages.title: Damage Debuff
related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
{{BuffInfobox
|name = Damage Debuff
|image = Transparent.png
|type = Debuff
|display = N/A
}}

==Description==
The '''Damage Debuff''' is a debuff applied by enemies that decreases a tower's damage. This debuff does not appear anywhere on the tower, though it does reduce the percentage of the tower's [[Damage Buff]].

==Mechanics==
The '''Damage Debuff''' effectively is just a negative [[Damage Buff]], best seen if a tower affected by it has a [[Damage Buff]]. For example, if a tower with a 20% [[Damage Buff]] receives a 15% '''Damage Debuff''', the [[Damage Buff]] will get reduced to 5%. Similarly, if a tower receives a '''Damage Debuff''' higher than its current [[Damage Buff]], the icon for it will be removed entirely. For example, if a tower with a 50% [[Damage Buff]] will receive a 60% '''Damage Debuff''', the icon for the buff will disappear and the tower will end up with a 10% '''Damage Debuff'''.

The damage affected by the '''Damage Debuff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Damage × (1 - (Damage Debuff - [[Damage Buff]]))'''</big>
:::where '''Damage Debuff''' and [[Damage Buff]] is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1). If the tower has no [[Damage Buff]] on itself, the number for it should be set to 0.

The damage of a tower affected by the '''Damage Debuff''' cannot be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower that deals 5 damage with a 50% '''Damage Debuff''' will deal 2 damage, instead of 2.5. The damage also cannot be lower than 1. For example, a tower with a 25% debuff will have its damage displayed as 0.75, but it will actually deal 1 damage, though some towers like the [[Shotgunner]] will break and actually deal nan damage.

==Applied By==
The following event enemies can apply the '''Damage Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Null Missile APC]] (''Null Missile Barrage'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Null Pursuit]] (''Missile Attack'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Rift Walker]] (''Dimensional Discharge'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Missile Ducky]] (''Widespread Terrorism'' ability, [[Ducky Revenge Event|Ducky Revenge]])

==Update History==
*'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]]
**'''Damage Debuff''' added.

==Description==
The '''Firerate Debuff''' is a debuff applied by enemies that increases a tower's firerate. This debuff does not appear anywhere on the tower.

==Mechanics==
The '''Firerate Debuff''' effectively is just a negative [[Firerate Buff]], best seen if a tower affected by it has a [[Firerate Buff]]. For example, if a tower with a 20% [[Firerate Buff]] receives a 15% '''Firerate Debuff''', the [[Firerate Buff]] will get reduced to 5%. Similarly, if a tower receives a '''Firerate Debuff''' higher than its current [[Firerate Buff]], the icon for it will be removed entirely. For example, if a tower with a 50% [[Firerate Buff]] will receive a 60% '''Firerate Debuff''', the icon for the buff will disappear and the tower will end up with a 10% '''Firerate Debuff'''.

The firerate affected by the '''Firerate Debuff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Original Firerate ÷ (1 + <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Firerate Buff]] - Firerate Debuff])'''</big>
:::where '''Firerate Debuff''' and [[Firerate Buff]] is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1). If the tower has no [[Firerate Buff]] on itself, the number for it should be set to 0.

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Firerate Debuff''':
*All [[units]].
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be increased.
*Tick of effects applied to enemies.
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be increased.
*The rev-up times of various towers, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]].
*Charge-up and cooldown of various burst or burst adjacent attacks, such as the [[Soldier]], [[Freezer]] and [[Accelerator]].
*Ability cooldowns.

==Applied By==
The following enemies can apply the '''Firerate Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Patient Zero]] (''Toxic'' ability)
*[[Necrotic Skeleton]] (''Gooey Demise'' ability)

The following event enemies can apply the '''Firerate Debuff''' to towers:

*[[Corrupted Titus]] (''Void Stream'' ability)
*[[Null Pyromancer]] (''Foul Breath'' ability)
*[[Null Sentry]] (''Firerate Drain'' ability)
*[[Rift Walker]] (''Dimensional Discharge'' ability)
*[[Referee]] (''Red Card'' ability)

The following event features can apply the '''Firerate Debuff''' to towers:
*[[The Star]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[The Chariot]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

The following enemies used to apply the '''Firerate Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Boomer]] (''Weakening Bile'' ability, formerly)

==Description==
The '''Range Debuff''' is a debuff applied by enemies that decreases a tower's range. This debuff does not appear anywhere on the tower, though due to how it works, it will reduce the percentage of the [[Range Buff]] on the tower or remove the [[Range Buff]] icon entirely.

==Mechanics==
The '''Range Debuff''' effectively is just a negative [[Range Buff]], best seen if a tower affected by it has a [[Range Buff]]. For example, if a tower with a 20% [[Range Buff]] receives a 15% '''Range Debuff''', the [[Range Buff]] will get reduced to 5%. Similarly, if a tower receives a '''Range Debuff''' higher than its current [[Range Buff]], the icon for it will be removed entirely. For example, if a tower with a 50% [[Range Buff]] will receive a 60% '''Range Debuff''', the icon for the buff will disappear and the tower will end up with a 10% '''Range Debuff'''.

The range affected by the '''Range Debuff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Range × (1 - (Range Debuff - [[Range Buff]]))'''</big>
:::where '''Range Debuff''' and [[Range Buff]] is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1). If the tower has no [[Range Buff]] on itself, the number for it should be set to 0.

The range of a tower affected by the '''Range Debuff''' can be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower with 5 range with a 50% '''Range Debuff''' will have a range of 2.5.

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Range Debuff''':
*All [[units]].
*The [[Shotgunner]], as its bullets do not extend into the decreased range.
*The [[DJ Booth]] cannot have its range boosted by another [[DJ Booth]].
**Other range buff sources, like the [[Ranger]], can still apply it.
*Circling/patrol range of the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]].
**The radius in which towers gain hidden detection from the [[Ace Pilot]] also cannot be decreased.
**These towers' attack range can still be decreased.
*The deadzone ranges of towers, like the [[Engineer]].
**The attack range for these towers can still be decreased.
*Secondary orange range of towers like the range buff range for the [[Ranger]] or the gravestone range for the [[Necromancer]].
**The main range of these towers can still be decreased.
*The chain range of the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Tesla]].
**The attack range can still be decreased.
*The explosion radius from [[Splash Damage|Splash Damage towers]] cannot be decreased.

==Applied By==
The following enemies can apply the '''Range Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Boomer]] (''Weakening Bile'' ability)
*[[Tanker]] (''Toxic Fumes'' ability)
*[[Elite Boomer]] (''Weakening Bile'' ability)

related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
{{BuffInfobox
|name = Cost Debuff
|image = Transparent.png
|type = Debuff
|display = N/A
}}

==Description==
The '''Cost Debuff''' is a debuff that increases a tower's placement and upgrade costs, but not ability costs. What is affected depends what it is applied by, as in some cases the '''Cost Debuff''' only affects the upgrade cost. This debuff is not displayed anywhere on the tower, the only way to tell it has been applied is by seeing the costs get boosted.

==Mechanics==
When applied, any affected cost is increased using this equation:
::<big>'''Cost × (1 + Cost Debuff)'''</big>
:::where '''Cost Debuff''' is the buff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The placement and upgrade costs are rounded down to the nearest integer.

Certain '''Cost Debuffs''' affect both tower placement and upgrade costs, and others only affect upgrade costs. Neither of them have shown to be able to affect ability usage costs. Towers that were placed down or upgraded while being affected the '''Cost Debuff''' will give you more cash back when sold, in comparison to those that were not affected by it.

==Applied By==
The following gamemodes used to apply the '''Cost Debuff''' to towers:
*[[MEGA Servers]] (Placement and upgrade cost)

The following modifiers apply the '''Cost Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Inflation]] (Placement, ability and upgrade cost)

The following towers used to have the '''Cost Debuff''':
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Scout]] (Upgrade cost only)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] (Upgrade cost only)

The following removed gamemodes could apply the '''Cost Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Halloween 2020 Event]] (Upgrade cost only)

==Update Log==
*'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]]
**'''Cost Debuff''' added.
*'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]]
**'''Cost Debuff''' variant which affects placement costs added.

==Description==
The '''Fatigue Debuff''' is a debuff that increases a tower's firerate, making them fire slower. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of a ball and chain.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Fatigue Debuff''' is calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate + Original Firerate × (Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff))'''</big>
::: where '''Fatigue Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Debuff''' is rounded up or down to the second decimal, this is only visual. The number can be far longer than what is displayed.

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] is calculated as:

::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) + (Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' is the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], '''Fatigue Debuff''' was calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1 + Firerate Debuff)'''</big>

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:

::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

**The {{Color|Premium|XR500}} is still affected, as the skin has a humanoid.
**Multiple skins added starting from the 1st of April 2025 also have this immunity due to bugs.
*All [[units]].
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be increased.
*Tick of effects applied to enemies.
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be increased.
*The rev-up times of various towers, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]]
*Charge-up and cooldown of various burst or burst adjacent attacks, such as the [[Soldier]], [[Freezer]] and [[Accelerator]].
*Ability cooldowns.

{{BuffInfobox
|name = Firerate Buff
|image = Cooldown Buff.png
|type = Buff
|display = Tower
}}

==Description==
The '''Firerate Buff''' is a buff that decreases a tower's firerate, making them fire faster. It is displayed on the towers using an icon of a lightning bolt.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Firerate Buff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Original Firerate ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Firerate Buff''' is the buff supplied is in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Buff''' is rounded up or down to the third decimal, this is only visual. 

Prior to the [[v2.0.0]] update, the firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:
::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' was the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[V1.1.0|Entity System Update]], the '''Firerate Buff''' was calculated as:

::Without the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1-Firerate Buff)'''</big>
::With the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 - Firerate Buff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Firerate Buff''':
*All [[units]].
*Ability cooldowns.
*Units spawnrates.
*The [[Commander]]; the [[Commander]] cannot boost the firerate of other [[Commander]]s.
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be decreased.
*Tick of the [[Pyromancer]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Slasher]] and [[Swarmer]].
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be decreased.
*The rev-up of the [[Minigunner]].
*Charge-up and cooldown of the [[Accelerator]].
**The cooldown of burst towers like the [[Soldier]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] also cannot be decreased.
*The [[Executioner]]; the firerate will not be decreased if the axe takes too long to return.
*The [[Archer]]; the '''Firerate Buff''' can decrease the time it takes for it to reload its bow, but it cannot decrease the time it takes it to aim at enemies.

The pump time for the [[Enforcer]] is also affected by this buff.

==Applied By==
The following towers have the '''Firerate Buff''':

*[[Gladiator]] (''Warrior's Call'' ability)

The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to other towers:

*[[Commander]] (Passive and ''Call to Arms'' ability)
*[[Medic]] (Passive to assigned towers)
*[[War Machine]] (Passive)
*[[Cooldown Flag]] (Passive)
*[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (Passive)
*[[Easter Egg]] (Passive for 20 seconds)
The following event enemies can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to towers:

* [[Null Guardian]] (''Null Aura'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
* [[Null Guardian Clone]] (''Null Aura'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
The following event features can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to towers:

* [[The Chariot]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

==Description==
The '''Scared Debuff''' is a debuff that decreases a tower's range. It is displayed on the tower itself using the icon of a ghost. Multiple ghosts will also appear out of the tower.

==Mechanics==
'''Scared Debuff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Range × (1 - Scared Debuff)'''</big>
:::where '''Scared Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The range of a tower affected by the '''Scared Debuff''' can be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower with 5 range with a 50% '''Scared Debuff''' will have a range of 2.5.

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Scared Debuff''':
*All towers that are not humanoids are immune to any debuff applied by enemies prior to the 28th of October 2023.
**Multiple skins added starting from the 1st of April 2025 also have this immunity due to bugs.
*All [[units]]..
*Circling/patrol range of the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]].
**The radius in which towers gain hidden detection from the [[Ace Pilot]] also cannot be decreased.
**These towers' attack range can still be decreased.
*The deadzone ranges of towers, like the [[Engineer]].
**The attack range for these towers can still be decreased.
*Secondary orange range of towers like the range buff range for the [[Ranger]] or the gravestone range for the [[Necromancer]].
**The main range of these towers can still be decreased.
*The chain range of the [[Electroshocker]].
**The attack range can still be decreased.
*The explosion radius from [[Splash Damage|Splash Damage towers]] cannot be decreased.

==Applied By==
The following enemies can apply the '''Scared Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Unstable Ice]] (''Avalanche'' ability)
*[[Nuclear Monster]] (''Blindly Shooting'' ability)
*[[Gunslinger]] (''Time's Up'' ability)
*[[Wox the Fox]] (''Game Over'' ability)
*[[Vindicator]] (''Blinding Carom'' ability)
*[[Void Reaver]] (''Cursed Blade'' ability)

The following event enemies can apply the '''Scared Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Conserver]] (''Spirit Release'' ability, [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]])
*[[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]] (''Spirit Release'' ability, [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]])
*[[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]] (''Spirit Release'' ability, [[Nil Zone]])
*[[Null Pyromancer]] (''Foul Breath'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Painter]] (''Paint Splatter'' ability, [[The Final Act Event|The Final Act]])
*[[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]] (''Hand Laser'' ability, [[The Final Act Event|The Final Act]])
*[[Referee]] (''Red Card'' ability, [[Backyard Legends Event|Backyard Legends]])

The following event enemies used to apply the '''Scared Debuff''' to towers, but no longer do so:
*[[Nerd Ducky]] (''Ducky Blast'' ability, [[Ducky Revenge Event|Ducky Revenge]])
